title: Border security first. But first before what?
kicker: Immigration · the 2013 Gang of Eight bill
dek: Words on the Senate floor and every roll call Marco Rubio cast on S. 744.

key_votes.text: on a motion to table an amendment that would have blocked provisional status until six months of effective border control.
